issues.description: The align-up arithmetic theorem and the executable AlignExt::align_up contract are accepted through admit, so callers receive lower-bound, divisibility, least-aligned-value, and nat_align_up equality guarantees that are not checked against the rounding implementation.
issues.rationale: The selected problem snapshot introduces a public arithmetic lemma whose proof body is admit and an unsigned-integer align_up implementation whose specification is discharged by a second admit. The repair chain first proves the nat rounding lemma, then removes the method admit while temporarily assuming the mask/modulo bridge, and finally proves that bridge. Commit 8488536c7972ae7e223853e2722efbe7f609988f is the first reviewed snapshot where the complete public align-up contract is checked without admit or assume.
issues.source_evidence: after/vstd_extra/src/arithmetic.rs:23-34 contains lemma_nat_align_up_sound with admit at line 33; after/ostd/libs/align_ext/src/lib.rs:55-69 specifies AlignExt::align_up and contains proof!{admit();} at line 68. Commits dfb8afc4a1ae4bb26b44f6a88eae192399c264e5 and 033aeb13a36590557a769f5a2044188778dfbddd partially repair the proof, and 8488536c7972ae7e223853e2722efbe7f609988f removes the remaining trust assumption.
issues.verification: Primary and independent second review confirmed the repair chain and this root's independence from align-down. Historical Verus was not executed; the finding is source- and fixed-Git-history-adjudicated.

issues.description: The align-down arithmetic theorem and the executable AlignExt::align_down contract are accepted through admit, so callers receive upper-bound, divisibility, greatest-aligned-value, and nat_align_down equality guarantees without a checked proof for the masking implementation.
issues.rationale: The selected problem snapshot introduces a separate public align-down theorem with an admit and a masking implementation whose contract is discharged by another admit. Commit 5152c6a7261e9ca2df511d4f42b98239a93d418d proves the nat theorem, and 8488536c7972ae7e223853e2722efbe7f609988f removes the public method admit using checked mask/modulo and bit-vector reasoning. This is independent from align-up because it establishes the opposite extremal property for a distinct public operation.
issues.source_evidence: after/vstd_extra/src/arithmetic.rs:36-47 contains lemma_nat_align_down_sound with admit at line 46; after/ostd/libs/align_ext/src/lib.rs:73-86 specifies AlignExt::align_down and contains proof!{admit();} at line 85. Commit 5152c6a7261e9ca2df511d4f42b98239a93d418d proves the arithmetic lemma, and 8488536c7972ae7e223853e2722efbe7f609988f completes the public method proof.
issues.verification: Primary and independent second review confirmed the repair chain and this root's independence from align-up. Historical Verus was not executed; the finding is source- and fixed-Git-history-adjudicated.
